title: CelFDrive: Multimodal deep learning-assisted microscopy for automated detection of rare events
description:
CelFDrive is a deep-learning-assisted workflow for automated microscopy. It detects configured cell states in overview images, then returns stage coordinates and capture metadata for a high-resolution workflow. The bundled detector is a fine-tuned YOLO11x object-detection model.

The current 3i-oriented SlideBook workflow has been deployed on lattice light-sheet (LLSM) and spinning-disk confocal (SDC) systems. CelFDrive can be adapted to control software that exchanges images and target coordinates with Python; each adaptation requires microscope-specific coordinate, capture-command, objective-offset, and hardware-safety validation. The repository also provides CellClicker annotation and training tools.

The detection model was trained on live-cell SiR-DNA-labelled human RPE-1 microscopy annotated for six mitotic stages. The associated training dataset is referenced as EMBL-EBI BioImage Archive accession S-BIAD3980 (DOI 10.6019/S-BIAD3980).
